summary: Passo 4 (access rules v2 ACTIVE in preview DB) tested end-to-end via public URL + app DB with TEST_ data (all cleaned). PASS: converted demo accounts (genitore.demo -> Aurora 'Genitore o tutore' with reports, role patient; tutore.demo -> Giulia Demo without the reserved gyn visit); two guardians A+B both get the minor's record (relation tutore), third account C with same CF gets nothing; 18-rule via PATCH birth_date (A loses record, fiscal_only reason maggiore_eta with only A-paid receipt, receipt PDF 200 for A / 404 for B, report PDF 404 for A, audit accesso_portale_chiuso); adult self access (relation paziente, 'La sua cartella'), delegation UI (consent checkbox gates button, A sees 'Familiare delegato', revoke removes it), backend 400 without consent / 403 for non-paziente / 409 duplicate / 404 revoke by non-owner; legal guardian (no portal-access-pending note, legal-access-toggle form, L sees 'Tutore legale / amministratore di sostegno' on adult record, duplicate 409 with toast, revoke via UI removes access); coming_of_age() in-process with mocked send_email sets adult_notice_sent_at, mails A+B, audit avviso_maggiore_eta; cron endpoint 401 without/with wrong Bearer; dashboard ComingOfAge card lists TEST patient with 'manca l'email del paziente'; SendToParents on reserved gyn visit disabled with hint 'Visita riservata: non si può inviare per email' (backend send-report 409). Requested regression: 22/23 pass - the 1 failure is a stale test asserting rules are NOT active.

minor.endpoint: access_rules.build_access.resync (used by delegation revoke, legal grant/revoke)
minor.issue: Same portal user is synced twice (portal_users_of() + find by email both return the stale doc before any sync) -> duplicate audit rows. Reproduced: one legal revoke produced 2 'accesso_portale_chiuso' entries for the same user_id; delegation revoke likewise. Fix: dedupe users by _id in resync (or re-fetch the user inside the loop).

Still legacy: always invites guardian_email ('Invita Genitore al Portale', copy about 'codice fiscale del bambino'). For an adult patient with patient_email it invites the parent, who under the new rules gets no access; guardian2_email is never invited. Should target patient_email when adult, and guardians (1-2) when minor; button label should adapt.

Audit loop zip(children, doc['children']) misaligns if child_view() returns None for a link (deleted patient) -> 'accesso_portale' audit rows attributed to wrong owner/relation. Build the audit inside the first loop.

integration_issues.issue: 'Invita Genitore al Portale' shown on adult patient passports (TEST 30y patient); see backend minor issue on /invite.

design_issues.screen: Scheda paziente > Documenti e consensi > Accessi al Portale
issues: Revoca of a legal guardian grant fires immediately with no confirm dialog (delegation revoke in portal does ask for confirmation) - consider confirming an action that closes access.

critical_code_review_comments: access_rules.coming_of_age scans all patients in the 17-19y window across ALL doctors (no tenant filter) - intended for cron, fine, but each run calls sync_links for every portal user of every adult patient whose invite was already sent? No: guarded by adult_invite_sent_at - OK.
fiscal_only() queries payment_transactions once per closed record (N+1); fine at current scale.
GET /access/coming-of-age iterates every patient of the doctor client-side in Python; consider a birth_date range query like coming_of_age().
SendToParents computes adulthood with new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') (UTC midnight) - off-by-one possible on birthday in negative-UTC timezones; backend is authoritative so low risk.
Auth playbook: bcrypt hashes ($2b$), httpOnly+secure cookies, CORS with explicit CORS_ORIGINS + credentials, lockout after 5 fails all present in auth.py.
